measurement_notes: CPU only; no equivalent-security claim. Sequential cases in recorded order, no concurrent benchmarks/tests intended. Each case reuses one key/index with fresh randomized encryption of the same plaintext query per trial. First search separate from remaining warm trials; no p95/throughput claim. Wall and process CPU seconds; both logical roles run on this host. GC before each query, not between phases. Setup and Nitro enrollment excluded from query timers and recorded separately. Raw cases use common MessagePack with implicit IDs; Nitro uses real protocol encoding/signatures/private checks but a SYNTHETIC test CA. No network, NSM, vsock, enclave isolation, HTTP/TLS, content retrieval, or live service. Same stable top-three sort is timed for every case; correctness checks are outside timers. Native raw BFV decoding is safe here only because all inputs are generated locally.
